title: Rigel and the Witch Head Nebula
reasoning: Reflection nebulae illuminated by bright supergiants always provide stunning visual targets for astrophotographers. IC 2118 near Rigel offers a classic case of pareidolia coupled with intricate interstellar dust structures.
summary: An astrophotograph captures IC 2118, a faint reflection nebula known popularly as the Witch Head Nebula due to its uncanny resemblance to a caricature. Illuminated by the bright blue supergiant Rigel, the sprawling dust cloud spans about 50 light-years.

title: M. John Harrison’s The End of Everything Wins the Booker Prize

title: Do AI Coding Agents Care About SemVer?
reasoning: This is a clever piece of practical engineering research that tests an assumption about how autonomous agents interact with codebases. It turns out that version numbers still act as a subtle psychological nudge even for LLMs.
summary: Microsoft researchers tested whether AI coding agents pay attention to semantic versioning when upgrading dependencies. Surprisingly, experiments revealed that version numbers alone changed how models handled byte-identical code modifications.
